summary: Amends specified provisions of the Angolan Penal Code approved by Lei n.º 38/20 and repeals specified provisions of that law and of the Code. Article 5 states that it enters into force on the date of publication.
notes: The source establishes the law’s publication date and its express commencement clause. The record’s current temporal status remains unknown because a broader repeal/amendment audit has not been completed.
The relation to Lei n.º 38/20 is confirmed by the title and Articles 1–3 of this Gazette text.
